mapper.sql: activity.*, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM crm_activity_participant participant WHERE participant.activity_id = activity.activity_id AND participant.tenant_id = activity.tenant_id AND participant.deleted = 0 AND participant.participant_type = 'USER' AND participant.participant_ref_id = #{userId} ) THEN #{userId} ELSE activity.owner_id END AS scope_owner_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_activity activity WHERE activity.activity_id = #{id} AND activity.deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM crm_activity WHERE activity_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: WHERE activity.tenant_id = #{activity.tenantId} AND activity.deleted = 0 AND activity.activity_id != #{activity.activityId} AND activity.status IN ('PLANNED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND activity.start_time < #{activity.endTime} AND activity.end_time > #{activity.startTime} AND (activity.owner_id IN #{person} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_activity_participant member WHERE member.tenant_id = activity.tenant_id AND member.activity_id = activity.activity_id AND member.deleted = 0 AND member.participant_type = 'USER' AND member.acceptance_status != 'DECLINED' AND member.participant_ref_id IN #{person}))
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM crm_activity activity
ORDER BY activity.start_time, activity.activity_id

SELECT activity.activity_id, activity.start_time, activity.end_time FROM crm_activity activity
ORDER BY activity.start_time, activity.activity_id

SELECT DISTINCT activity.activity_id FROM crm_activity activity INNER JOIN crm_activity_reminder reminder ON reminder.activity_id = activity.activity_id AND reminder.tenant_id = activity.tenant_id WHERE activity.deleted = 0 AND activity.status IN ('PLANNED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND reminder.sent_flag = 0 AND DATE_SUB(activity.start_time, INTERVAL reminder.remind_minutes_before MINUTE) <= #{now} ORDER BY activity.activity_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = '0' AND user_id IN #{userId}
mapper.sql: (activity.owner_id = #{viewerId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_activity_participant viewer WHERE viewer.tenant_id = activity.tenant_id AND viewer.activity_id = activity.activity_id AND viewer.deleted = 0 AND viewer.participant_type = 'USER' AND viewer.participant_ref_id = #{viewerId}))
mapper.select: SELECT account.user_id, 'CRM' AS module, CASE WHEN THEN activity.activity_id ELSE NULL END AS business_id, CASE WHEN THEN activity.subject ELSE '忙碌时段' END AS title, AS details_visible, activity.start_time, activity.end_time FROM crm_activity activity JOIN sys_user account ON account.tenant_id = activity.tenant_id AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND account.user_id IN #{userId} WHERE activity.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND activity.deleted = 0 AND activity.status IN ('PLANNED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND activity.start_time < #{end} AND activity.end_time > #{start} AND (activity.owner_id = account.user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_activity_participant participant WHERE participant.tenant_id = activity.tenant_id AND participant.activity_id = activity.activity_id AND participant.deleted = 0 AND participant.participant_type = 'USER' AND participant.participant_ref_id = account.user_id AND participant.acceptance_status != 'DECLINED')) ORDER BY activity.start_time, activity.activity_id, account.user_id
